author.name: Olia Chernova
author.role: PhD (c), Wellness Enthusiast and Co-Founder, COO at Biohackers World

intro: At a [health and wellness conference in Miami](https://www.biohackers.world/events/miami2024), Tess Cheng, a seasoned Health and Wellness Coach, sat down with Justin Roethlingshoefer, the founder of OWN IT Coaching, to discuss the transformative power of taking ownership of one’s health. [Justin](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/justin-roethlingshoefer), with his background as an NHL performance coach and founder of OWN IT, shared insights on health optimization, personalized strategies, and the role of data in making better health decisions.

blocks.text: From Personal Struggles to Professional Insights

Justin’s health journey began at an early age, motivated by a desire to change the world’s health. However, personal struggles including being bullied for his weight, experiencing anorexia, and battling depression shaped his understanding of wellness. “Your body doesn’t know the difference between different forms of stress—mental, physical, spiritual, emotional,” Justin reflected, highlighting how stress impacts overall well-being. He combined his own experiences with academic knowledge, earning degrees in nutrition, exercise science, and a postgraduate doctorate.

At 24, Justin joined the NHL as a performance coach, where he integrated data from multiple health domains—nutrition, strength, and mental performance to optimize team health. Under his guidance, the team became one of the least injured in the league.
The Birth of OWN IT Coaching

In 2020, Justin launched OWN IT Coaching to provide a holistic, data-driven approach to health optimization. The company blends mental performance coaches, dietitians, strength trainers, and functional doctors into one integrated ecosystem. This personalized, proactive approach helps clients make data-informed health decisions rather than reacting to problems as they arise. OWN IT has since grown to a team of 40, serving thousands of clients.
The Power of Personalization and Data in Health

Personalization is central to Justin’s philosophy. “If we could understand the language our body is communicating to us, we’d take much better ownership of our health,” he explained. Instead of relying on opinions or emotions, he advocates for making health decisions based on data, which empowers individuals to take control of their well-being.

As biohacking becomes more popular, Justin cautions that technology alone can’t fix a bad lifestyle. “There’s no tech that can overcome poor habits,” he said. He emphasized the importance of Heart Rate Variability (HRV) in understanding how lifestyle choices, like sleep and diet, affect our health. HRV serves as a guide for making better, more informed decisions.

Maintaining health amidst busy schedules is a common challenge. Tess Cheng asked Justin how to stay healthy while traveling and managing hectic workdays. Justin’s advice? “Progress isn’t about perfection. It’s about the pursuit of better.” Even small changes, like consistent sleep patterns or short meditation breaks, can lead to significant improvements.
AI and Coaching for Real Change

As AI technology evolves, it increasingly integrates with health coaching, offering real-time data to help clients make smarter decisions. AI provides immediate feedback on how habits—like alcohol consumption affect health metrics such as HRV, allowing individuals to adjust their behaviors for better results. Combining AI with coaching offers personalized, proactive support, making health optimization more effective.
Breaking Down Silos for Holistic Health

One challenge many people face is managing various aspects of wellness in isolation. Whether it’s working with a trainer, nutritionist, or therapist, these experts often don’t communicate with one another, leading to fragmented advice. Justin’s approach integrates multiple health professionals, providing a unified, holistic plan that complements all areas of wellness.
The Role of Accountability and Support

True transformation requires more than just motivation—it requires a team of experts providing accountability and support. When clients are guided by a team, they are more likely to stick to their health goals. This support system helps clients avoid slipping back into unhealthy habits.
Conclusion: Unlocking Your Full Health Potential

Justin’s journey emphasizes that health ownership is a lifelong commitment. By using data, personalized strategies, and a holistic coaching approach, individuals can achieve lasting health transformation. With the right support, backed by both technology and a cohesive team of experts, anyone can take control of their health.
